brief:
Israel's intensifying operations across the West Bank—including settlement expansion and displacement of Palestinians—threaten to destabilize Jordan's eastern border and strain the 1994 peace treaty between the two countries, Al Jazeera English reported. The escalation creates a direct security and humanitarian challenge for Amman, which hosts hundreds of thousands of Palestinian refugees and relies on regional stability.

Jordan faces limited options as Israeli control deepens in the territory. Any military response risks broader conflict, while diplomatic channels have shown little effect in restraining settlement activity or halting displacement operations that contradict international law.
dek: Settlement expansion, displacement and growing Israeli control would have direct consequences for Jordan.
title: Jordan weighs response to Israeli escalation across West Bank
